I will write the scene as a single JSON plan object in structured screenplay-beat form.

Scene 6 is a setup beat. The player will lean closer and linger their hands together. This visible gesture must advance the A-plot of spreading rumors and collapsing reputation.

The scene is set in the Fatelands during the First Favored, First Sacrifice rite. The PC is trapped between claiming and denying a released memory. Julian is present. The narrative stays in first-person present tense.

The scene continues from the prior ending. The memory pulses and succeeds where it should fail. Julian remains silent. The PC must speak or force fade.
